## FAO HITL Sweeper v1

**Controls:** FAO-GOV-004, FAO-GOV-007, FAO-GOV-008

Every 5 minutes, **Run Sweep** calls `fao_maintenance_sweep`. In the database it expires unclaimed run tokens, fails stale runs, expires overdue requests (HITL_EXPIRED, then COMMITTED with FAILURE), writes escalation events, and lists the notifications that are due.

- **Expand Notifications** turns the escalation and re-notify lists into notifier inputs; the notifier runs once per item and one failure does not stop the others
- **Check Notifier Results** runs after every item was attempted and fails the execution when any notifier call failed (FAO-GOV-007), so a failed call is never silent
- **Check Sweep Errors** runs on every sweep and fails the execution when any sweep item failed, so it shows in n8n

Deadlines do not depend on this schedule: `fao_hitl_decide` refuses a decision at or after the deadline on its own.

**Publish (n8n 2.x):** step 4 of 5 (Writer, notifier, error handler, sweeper, flagship). Publish after the notifier; its schedule starts sweeping as soon as it is published.
